question: How do I use a canonical URL for a republished article? Does it redirect visitors or change the sitemap?
expected: canonical_url absoluteHTTP(S)/sitepath; no redirect; sitemap false excludesduplicate actualURL.

question: Can I set different browser, social and visible titles, and a separate meta description?
expected: seo_title og_title title and description; page description takes precedence.

question: How do I set Open Graph language metadata for zh-Hant and translated versions?
expected: locale zh-Hant og_locale zh_TW alternate list; no automatictranslations/hreflang.

question: Does schema_image crop images or change the visible header and sharing image?
expected: URLorlist for BlogPosting; no crops/verification; independentog_image/header_img.

question: Why are related and random cards empty, and will random cards change on every reload?
expected: tagcandidatepool2same3differenttagthreshold; <=3; buildtime notonreload.

question: How do I add breadcrumb links and a GitHub button in my page header?
expected: show_breadcrumb breadcrumb_list labelurl; project_links urliconlabel.

question: How do I configure reading speed and the numbered blog pagination window?
expected: words_per_minute default200 paginator_maxnum default3 clamp2..total notpaginationenabler.

question: How does landingpage differ from default, and how do I hide its header?
expected: layout landingpage sameoptions bg/textvars; header_type none.

question: How do I change the table of contents sidebar background and navbar link hover background?
expected: chulapa-toc-bg and navbar-chulapa-hover-bg-color under chulapa-skin.vars; quoted hex colors; restart Jekyll.

question: Can I override landingpage-card-bg through vars, and does changing blue always change my skin's primary color?
expected: landingpage-card-bg is recalculated, not an overridable default; use component variables or custom CSS; explicit primary does not follow blue.

question: Which variables change the hamburger stroke, toggle button background and custom toggle icon?
expected: navbar-chulapa-toggler-color stroke, navbar-chulapa-toggler-color-bg button background, navbar-chulapa-toggler-icon-bg Sass url expression replaces icon.

question: Which Chulapa variable sets the chatbot model temperature?
expected: No documented Sass variable for model temperature; acknowledge missing context and do not invent a setting.

question: How do I enable Mermaid diagrams? Does this work with the v2.1.0 gem and what happens if the CDN fails?
expected: Development after v2.1.0 only; mermaid: true YAML boolean and fenced mermaid block; no extra plugin; CDN loads only enabled diagrams; source remains on failure.

question: I want a portfolio with Chulapa. Is there a small starter, does it filter projects and does it deploy automatically?
expected: examples/portfolio with projects collection and two sample projects; copy contents edit config; card index has no filtering; no deployment workflow; recommend chulapa-101 for a new site with publishing configured.

question: What does chulapa-101 include, where do I edit it and does it select one of four starter profiles?
expected: One personal blog with three sample posts, About, local credited photo, year/category/tag archives, Fuse.js search and RSS, using predefined gitdev. Root index.html is paginated at five posts per page; content in _posts, _pages and assets/img, navigation in _config.yml, which follows full theme sections/comments with empty unused options and blog-specific defaults. Optional comment-only _includes/custom hooks and assets/css/custom.scss with front matter are included, without changing the skin. No profile selector or extra build script. Existing publishing workflows are included; distinct from four minimal examples without workflows.

question: Does the keyboard update make the lateral TOC a modal or remove its Tab navigation? Is Chulapa now WCAG certified?
expected: Development after v2.1.0; floating navbar update is separate; lateral TOC retains open/close and Tab behavior without focus trap or modal role; no WCAG certification or guaranteed production score.

question: With the development theme, where does the Chulapa font load from and does configuring Cactus load it on every page?
expected: Font served from installed theme assets with baseurl in preload and CSS; Cactus script and stylesheet only when show_comments is true; Google Fonts and Font Awesome still external. Not in v2.1.0.

question: How do I highlight the current section in the sidebar table of contents? Does this change keyboard focus or need another YAML setting?
expected: Development after v2.1.0: automatic highlighting for show_toc, show_sidetoc and kramdown TOCs with JavaScript and aria-current location. No additional YAML setting; only included, rendered headings (skip closed or hidden containers); sidebar Tab order and keyboard focus unchanged. Anchor links work without JavaScript.

question: How do I enable a PhotoSwipe lightbox on a masonry gallery? Is there a page YAML option or Jekyll plugin, and does this work in v2.1.0?
expected: Development after v2.1.0 only. include_cached snippets/masonry.html internal="gallery" photoswipe=true; boolean Liquid include parameter, no page YAML setting or extra plugin. Default disabled, CDN assets load when an image is opened, original image links work without JavaScript. Each gallery isolated; keyboard/Escape/focus restoration and reduced motion. Also works for carousel.

question: How do I add GoatCounter to Chulapa? Does setting it replace Google Analytics and track localhost development? Does it use canonical URLs, and should I also insert the tracker in a custom hook?
expected: Development after v2.1.0: goatcounter is the complete public HTTPS /count endpoint, hosted or self-hosted. Create site in GoatCounter separately; no API key/plugin. Official async gc.zgo.at/count.js only in JEKYLL_ENV=production; default disabled, development excluded and upstream ignores localhost. Google unchanged; clear gtag_id and analytics_id to use only GoatCounter. No live counter widget/custom events. Not in v2.1.0. Prefers the path from a same-domain canonical URL (www equivalent); otherwise browser path. Ignores cross-domain canonicals. Chulapa provides canonical links including baseurl; no extra tag or duplicate tracker in custom hooks needed.

question: How do I list a collection as cards in ascending filename order? Is that the default, and do gallery files use the same field?
expected: Use layout: indexcategory, include_collection with the desired collection, index_sort: name and index_sort_asc: true. Default field name and default descending order; index_items defaults to 10 and limits after sorting. Internal masonry/carousel static files use index_sort="basename" and index_sort_asc=true, not the document name field.

question: Does deferred YouTube load the player API before I click? If the jQuery CDN fails, can I still copy code? Does pressing Enter in Lunr search reload the page? Does floating navigation work on the search layout?
expected: v2.1.1-dev on main, not v2.1.0: deferred YouTube inserts a youtube-nocookie iframe on activation without loading player API beforehand; requests autoplay subject to browser policy; noscript link available. Native copying and accessible feedback work without jQuery/Bootstrap, graphical tooltips require them. Lunr index reused; input debounced 150ms, Enter immediately searches without reload. Floating navigation works on search pages using a shared navigation script.

question: I copied an old custom search page and now Fuse or Lunr says ChulapaSearch is not defined. What should I update? How do I keep FAB navigation working?
expected: v2.1.1-dev: direct readable/minified Lunr and Fuse adapters require assets/js/chulapa_search.js before initialization, plus their provider library and generated store before the adapter. Standard search layout handles dependencies. Update local overrides together. Custom document shells should include components/scripts.html once for Bootstrap dependencies and chulapa_navigation.js for fab/dual; layouts inheriting minimal/search already handle it. No new YAML options. Link JavaScript assets and local overrides and complete demo sources.

question: The documentation chat shows my old messages after reloading. Does the AI remember them when I ask a follow-up question?
expected: Displayed messages/draft can be restored from sessionStorage in the current tab. Each request sends only the current question; displayed history is not model conversation context. Include needed details in each question. Clear chat resets the saved messages/draft. This assistant is a docs-site extension, not bundled in the theme.

question: En la versión de desarrollo, ¿qué mejoras semánticas tiene Chulapa para lectores de pantalla y teclado? ¿Tengo que activar algo en YAML?
expected: v2.1.1-dev changes after v2.1.0: logical list/search headings, named thumbnail links, current-page navbar destinations, native dropdown/carousel buttons supporting Enter/Space, search landmarks and polite Lunr/Fuse result-count announcements, labelled Welcomments comment field and no empty author aside when disabled. No new YAML settings and no WCAG certification. Link accessibility/performance guide. Do not claim announcements for Google, Algolia or Simple-Jekyll-Search.

question: ¿El carrusel respeta el movimiento reducido? ¿Cómo lo pauso y uso los indicadores con teclado? ¿Necesito YAML nuevo?
expected: v2.1.1-dev after v2.1.0: positive interval and more than one slide show pause/start button with Bootstrap; interval=0 disables cycling and hides button. Reduced motion starts paused; keyboard/pointer interaction pauses until explicit start, hover pauses temporarily on hover-capable devices. Preference change to reduce stops rotation and change back does not restart. Indicators are named native buttons with current state and Enter/Space. New local controller loaded by standard layouts. No new YAML. Link carousel and accessibility guide.

question: Con el TOC lateral cerrado, ¿sus enlaces siguen entrando en Tab? ¿Escape funciona? ¿Atrapa el foco al abrirse?
expected: v2.1.1-dev: closed sidebar is inert and aria-hidden, so offscreen controls are outside focus order. Open sidebar keeps existing Tab order through close button and links. Escape from panel/trigger closes and returns focus to trigger; button/overlay close also restores focus. It is not modal and does not trap focus. No new YAML option. Link accessibility guide.

question: ¿Chulapa ya es una PWA? ¿Hay una opción YAML para usarla offline, incluido el chatbot?
expected: Reusable theme has no built-in service worker, offline cache or PWA YAML option. Docs favicon manifest has standalone display and 192/384 icons but no explicit start_url/scope or 512 icon; manifest alone does not establish cross-browser installability or offline support. PWA customization requires site-specific manifest/HTTPS/baseurl/icon and caching/update/fallback review. External dependencies and live AI require connectivity; do not claim offline chatbot. Link PWA/offline section of accessibility guide.
